title: Balochistan Local Government Election Fifth Amendment Ordinance 2001

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Local Government Election Fifth Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XIX OF 2001
BALOCHISTAN LOCAL
GOVERNMENT ELECTION (FIFTH AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XIX OF 2001
An Ordinance further to amend the Balochistan Local
Government Election Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 22nd August, 2001]
No., Legis.-1-122(Law)/2000-IV,
dated 22-8-2001.---The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 20th August, 2001, is hereby published for general
information:--
1. Short title and
commencement. ---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Balochistan Local
Government Election (Fifth Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Local Government Election Fifth Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Amendment of section 18 of Ordinance VI of 2000

ORDINANCE XIX OF 2001
BALOCHISTAN LOCAL
GOVERNMENT ELECTION (FIFTH AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XIX OF 2001
An Ordinance further to amend the Balochistan Local
Government Election Ordinance, 2000
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 22nd August, 2001]
No., Legis.-1-122(Law)/2000-IV,
dated 22-8-2001.---The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 20th August, 2001, is hereby published for general
information:--
2. Amendment of section 18 of
Ordinance VI of 2000.--In the Balochistan Local Government Election
Ordinance, 2000, hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance for existing
section 18-A, the following shall be substituted:--
"18-A. Election to vacant
seats.--(1) If a seat of a member remains unfilled or becomes vacant during
the term of office of a Council, a new member shall be elected through
by-election and the member elected in by election shall hold Office for the
remaining portion of the term of the Council.
(2) If any seat reserved for
women remains vacant, the same shall be filled through by-elections and the
elected women member shall hold office for the remaining portion of the term of
the Council.
(3) All by-elections shall be
held once a year on a date or dates fixed by the Chief Election Commissioner.
(4) A vacancy of Union Nazim or
Naib Union Nazim shall be filled through by-election within sixty days of the
occurrence of vacancy.
(5) A vacancy of Zila Nazim, Naib
Zila Nazim, Tehsil Nazim or Town Nasim, Tehsil Naib Nazim or Town Naib Nazim
shall be filled through by-election within thirty days of the occurrence of
vacancy:
(6) When the office of a Zila
Nazim or Naib Zila Nazim, Tehsil Nazim, or Town 'Nazim,. Naib Tehsil Nazim, or
Naib Town Nazim, Union Nazim, or Naib Union Nazim remains unfilled or falls
vacant, the members of the concerned Council shall be a majority vote elect an
officiating Nazim or Naib Nazim as the case may be from amongst its members and
the person so elected shall continue to retain his office as a member also:
Provided that the officiating
Nazim or Naib Nazim shall not be a candidate in the by-election held for
election of the Nazim and Naib Nazim respectively."
